purpose: Requirements for the consult skill, which runs dialogue with users so they understand topics and give correct decisions, covering progress tables, briefs, confidence, and recording.
summary: Overview: consult is responsible for dialogue; three uses (review, dialogue-based fixing, new creation)
Terminology: evaluation, consult topic, consult brief, presentation state, dialogue use
Scope: in-scope presentation, Q&A, decision capture; out-of-scope generation and unrequested execution
Prerequisites: review JSON exchange of findings and evaluations; dialogue input from conversation context
FNC-001/002: topic intake and verification; progress table with status, results, issues, and skill-led progression
FNC-003 to 006: two-field consult brief (summary and recommendation), confidence marks, context restatement, brevity about 10 lines
FNC-007 to 010: Q&A, decision capture, interruption/hold/out-of-scope handling, user owns settlement
FNC-012 to 014: main Claude authors briefs before addressing user; briefs recorded by script as JSON
BL-001/002 and NFR: no execution of undecided items, faithful presentation, single state location, use-independence, secret non-disclosure, failure visibility
Open items TBD-002 to TBD-010 such as batch threshold, record location, resumption
tasks: Implementing or modifying the consult skill
Designing consult presentation formats and progress tables
Integrating review delegation of findings to consult
Writing consult briefs and confidence marks per rules
Implementing the HTML generation script for dialogue use
title: REQ-017 consult 対話進行スキル要件定義書
